newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-KIEFER WINS SENIOR DU MAURIER CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-KIEFER WINS SENIOR DU MAURIER CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Jack Kiefer fired a 3-under-par 68 Sunday to claim a two-stroke victory over Jim Colbert in the $1.1 million du Maurier Champions Senior tournament at the St. George's Golf and Country Club.
It was the second Senior Tour victory for the 57-year-old Kiefer and his first since the 1994 Ralphs Senior Classic.
Kiefer, who started the final round one shot behind Colbert, wound up at 15-under 269. Colbert carded a final-round 71 to finish at 13-under.
Graham Marsh, who was tied with Kiefer after three rounds, shot 72 to finish four shots back at 11-under.
"I felt like I was due in Canada," said Kiefer, who tied for third last year.
"I let it get away last year and I thought I let this tournament get away yesterday. I played almost as good as I can play this week," added Kiefer, who earned $165,000.
"This Tour completely changed my life. If not for the Senior Tour, I'd still be at the driving range I owned."
